verdict.rationale: Pipecat's docs render a live Mintlify 'Try it' playground for each endpoint of the Pipecat Cloud REST reference, with generated cURL examples and runnable in-page requests, backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. The interactive, runnable reference is documented only for the Cloud REST API, not for the core Python framework API. missing for 10: interactive runnable examples for the open-source framework API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works, evidence of runnable examples beyond generated cURL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Pipecat Cloud REST reference renders a live "Try it" API playground per endpoint (the Mintlify api.playground runtime)
with generated cURL examples and a runnable in-page request
Download the complete spec to generate clients, run mocks, or feed to AI tools.
